subject.title: Gateway silently skips channel initialization on plugin/runtime mismatch or missing module files

question: What startup contract should Gateway use when a configured channel's owner plugin is installed but fails before channel registration?
rationale: The code can warn today for some blocked or missing owners, but choosing fail-fast versus warn-and-continue, the audit shape, and whether hot reload/performance work belongs here is a product and upgrade-safety decision.

options.title: Warn-and-continue with a channel audit
options.body: Keep Gateway startup non-fatal but emit a configured-channel attempted/loaded/failed summary that ties plugin load and registration failures back to the affected channel and repair path.

options.title: Fail fast for configured mismatches
options.body: Treat incompatible or broken configured channel plugins as startup-blocking errors, accepting the upgrade risk that existing gateways may stop until repaired.

options.title: Split broad follow-ups
options.body: Scope this issue to startup diagnostics and track hot reload, Feishu API timeout severity, and large-plugin performance caching as separate product decisions.

recommendation.title: Warn-and-continue with a channel audit
recommendation.body: Keep Gateway startup non-fatal but emit a configured-channel attempted/loaded/failed summary that ties plugin load and registration failures back to the affected channel and repair path.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history and VISION-aligned product scope make steipete the best available owner for the Gateway startup behavior choice.
